purpose: Teach: 下方/私鉄/郵貯/竣工/インサイド/四方/ロイター/パーフェクト

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費の下方修正に備えろ
lines.en: Ren, prepare for cuts to the research budget.
lines.style: Direct, measured command. No warmth, no edge. Matter-of-fact opening. Expects compliance. Brief pause after the name—professional distance but not unkind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。私鉄に乗って学会に通います
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll manage the commute to the conference.
lines.style: Quick affirmation. Slightly breathless—eager to show he's already thinking ahead. Quiet, respectful. The tone of someone proving themselves without asking for recognition.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、奨学金は郵貯口座でも受けられる
lines.en: Ren, scholarships come through postal savings accounts too—look into it.
lines.style: Practical advice delivered as instruction. Slight downward inflection, like sharing something useful he's already considered. Brief, efficient. A small gesture of help disguised as direction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究棟の竣工に立ち会います
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll attend the research building opening ceremony.
lines.style: Immediate agreement. Precise and steady. No hesitation. The reply of someone taking mental notes and committing to follow through without needing to be reminded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究分野のインサイド情報も集めろ
lines.en: Ren, gather intelligence from inside the field too.
lines.style: Command tone sharpens slightly. Strategic, not punitive. Suggests scope beyond the obvious. Steady, authoritative. The kind of guidance that teaches lateral thinking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。四方の研究室と交流します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll coordinate with labs across the department.
lines.style: Immediate commitment. Clear and deliberate. No apology in the tone. Shows he understands the assignment and has already begun planning. Controlled, professional.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、ロイター科学記事も読め
lines.en: Ren, read the Reuters science coverage.
lines.style: Final directive. Clipped, efficient. Tone suggests this is non-negotiable but still calibrated—not harsh, just clear. The last piece of the instruction set.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験をパーフェクトに進めます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll execute the experiments flawlessly.
lines.style: Quiet conviction in the opening affirmation. Slight tension in 'flawlessly'—self-imposed standard, not boasting. Controlled, steady close. The tone of someone who will hold himself to it.
